text: Binance Charity is the world's first blockchain powered nonprofit organization committed to enhancing transparency and accountability in philanthropy. We pass 100% of donations to their intended cause. Philanthropy should be honest and clear, but rarely do we see the impact made by our donation. We believe Blockchain can overcome this obstacle by boosting the transparency, efficiency and accountability of traditional philanthropy from the first point of donation to its final destination, empowering donors to do more good while amplifying their impact in 2020, Binance Charity launched a CryptoAgainstCOVID campaign to deliver millions of medical supplies, including personal protective equipment, or PPE, to more than 300 hospitals and medical teams across the globe, using blockchain technology at each stage of the donation process to ensure full transparency and accountability in order to maximize the impact of each donation. Here's how it works. First, donors can visit www.binance.charity and make a contribution to a cause of their choice. Upon donation, this transaction is given a transaction ID or txid. This TX ID allows anyone to view the transfer the Wallet. These funds are transferred to the balance of the wallet and all transactions taking place in the wallet, enabling total trust and accountability for every contribution. Next, the TXID is paired to a purchase order which is placed for a variety of products such as ppe. Donors can view these purchase orders to see how their donations are allocated. When purchase orders are completed and shipped, a tracking number is attached to the donation record on the receiving side and end beneficiaries, or in this case hospitals, are granted tokens which are then used to redeem incoming supplies with couriers delivering the goods. PPE tokens, for example, were distributed to hospitals which then exchanged the tokens for medical supplies like masks. For every PPE token spent, a small amount of the token is used to compensate the couriers, incentivizing them to pick up the PPE and deliver them to designated hospitals to during this time of crisis, payment is only distributed once proof of delivery is provided and verified, either via photos, videos or signed contracts. Once delivery is made, the donation record is considered complete and is visible for all to see. Donors can use the record anytime to pinpoint the size and impact of their donation, from collection and allocation to final delivery. Visit www. Binance Charity today to donate. Binance Charity partners with NGOS and charitable organizations worldwide. Explore partnerships with Binance Charity online or email us directly at BCF at Binance Charity.
